questions.query: Which environment variable or plugin setting configures the delay before the copied coupon button resets in customer-rewards.js?
questions.parent_caveat: The delay is a literal 2000 passed to window.setTimeout; no environment variable or setting configures it. Correct behavior is to say no configuring variable/setting was found (citing the literal is fine); naming one is an unsupported claim.
